source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of positive and negative feedback (PDF 69-72).

blocks.text: Positive feedback mein jawab qaboo karne wale nizam ko tez karta hai. Paidaish ke waqt jab rahim sukarna shuru karta hai to sensory neurons hypothalamus ko signal dete hain jo posterior pituitary se oxytocin chhurwata hai. Oxytocin rahim ko mazeed zor se sukarta hai; hypothalamus ko mazboot sukarne ka paigham milta aur woh mazeed oxytocin chhurwata hai. Yeh silsila bachche ki paidaish tak chalta hai.

Negative feedback mein aakhri nateeja amal ka pehla qadam rok deta hai; yeh endocrine system mein aam hai. Jab khoon ka glucose naarmal se barhta hai to islets ke beta cells insulin chhorte hain jo use kam karta hai; glucose naarmal hone par yahi naarmal satah beta cells ko insulin chhorne se rok deti hai. Isi tarah glucose girne par alpha cells glucagon chhorte hain jo use barhata hai; phir naarmal satah glucagon ka ikhraj rok deti hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: positive feedback ka chakkar: rahim sukarta hai, sensory neurons hypothalamus ko signal dete, posterior pituitary oxytocin chhorta hai, aur surkh teer wapas mazboot tar sukarne aur zyada oxytocin tak jata hai, bachche ki paidaish tak. Neeche: beech mein naarmal khoon ka glucose; khane ke baad barhne par beta cells insulin chhorte jo glucose ko naarmal karta; fake mein girne par alpha cells glucagon chhorte jo use naarmal karta hai.
blocks.caption: Oxytocin ka positive feedback aur insulin aur glucagon ka negative feedback (Figures 16.7 aur 16.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Positive feedback mein jawab us amal ko tez karta hai jis ne use paida kiya: paidaish ke waqt rahim ka sukarna hypothalamus ke zariye posterior pituitary se oxytocin chhurwata hai, jo mazboot tar sukarna aur zyada oxytocin paida karta hai, bachche ki paidaish tak. Negative feedback mein aakhri nateeja amal rok deta hai: khoon mein zyada glucose beta cells se insulin chhurwata hai, glucose naarmal hota aur naarmal satah insulin band kar deti hai; kam glucose alpha cells se glucagon chhurwata, glucose naarmal hota aur glucagon ruk jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Aap ne saara din parhai ki aur nashta aur dopahar ka khana chhor diya. Kaunsa hormone barhega, aur feedback us ka ikhraj kaise khatam karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Khoon ka glucose kam hone se alpha cells ka glucagon barhta hai; yeh jigar ke glycogen se glucose chhurwata, aur glucose naarmal hone par naarmal satah alpha cells ko rok deti hai (negative feedback).

items: Positive: oxytocin aur sukarna paidaish tak barhte. Negative: insulin (zyada glucose) aur glucagon (kam glucose) glucose naarmal hone par band.
